layman_headline: All three positions are slightly underwater in a fearful market — patience is the play.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a 'Fear' state with Bitcoin down about 3% for the week and altcoins broadly weak. Our three open positions (SOL, LINK, and FET) are each down roughly 2%, but none have hit their stop-loss levels. The swing candidates on the watchlist are either wildly overbought after 100%+ pumps or lacking the technical data needed to justify entry. There's no compelling new setup worth the risk right now.
layman_action: Hold your current positions and wait. All three trades are within normal pullback range. Only act if a stop-loss is hit or a clear new catalyst emerges.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates present poor risk/reward: VELVET (+130% 7d, RSI 60) and AKE (+132% 7d, RSI 92) are chase trades with extreme correction risk. FET is already held. H is pulling back -7.5% intraday after a +76% weekly run — classic blow-off top pattern. SOL is stable but lacks a catalyst. With BTC dominance at 56.2% and Fear & Greed at 31, the market environment is hostile for new alt entries. Our three existing positions are all within 2.5% of entry and well above stop-losses. The prudent move is to hold and wait for either our targets to be hit or a market regime shift.
risk_factors: BTC could break below $60,000 support, dragging all alts lower and triggering stop-losses on current positions
Fear & Greed at 31 and declining could deteriorate further into extreme fear, causing broader capitulation
High BTC dominance (56.2%) signals continued capital rotation away from altcoins
watch_list: BTC price action around $60,000-$62,000 support zone — a break below would be bearish for all positions
Fear & Greed trend — currently 'improving' from weekly avg of 30.4; watch if it reverses below 25
LINK holding above $9.00 support and FET holding above $0.112 stop-loss level
market_context: The crypto market is in a fear-driven consolidation phase with BTC at $62,859 and dominance at 56.2%. Altcoins are broadly weak, with a few micro/small-caps seeing parabolic spikes that are likely unsustainable.
context_banner: Fear-state market with no quality setups — discipline means sitting on hands while existing positions work.
